kftvA tu rAsamaRqalam । gopAnAM SatakaM kfttvA gopInAM SatakantaTA ॥ SilAyAM pratimAyAM vA SrIkfzRaM rAGayA saha । BArate pUjayet kftvA copahArARi zoqaSa ॥ goloke ca vaset so'pi yAvadvE brahmaRo vayaH kalpataruyAtreyam । asya viDiryaTA, -- “kArttike pOrRamAsyAntu rAsayAtrA mahAniSi । nandasUnoH prakarttavyA mahAviBavavistarEH ॥ iha loke suKaM prApya ante vizRupuraM vrajet ॥ pUjA kAryyArdDarAtre tu nayet SezaM mahotsavEH । gItErnAnAviDErvAdyErvveRuvIRAmfdaNgakEH ॥ nftyErvarANganAgItEraNganAnAYca kIrttanEH । candanAgurukastUrIpaNkalepErvvirAjitEH ॥ viharadBirvizRuBaktEH kAryya eza mahotsavaH । DyAyedvfndAvane ramye yamunApuline vane ॥ nikuYjasadane kfzRaM gopImaRqalamaRqitam । rAsamaRqalayantrasya govindaM karRikAgatam ॥ dbayordvayorgopikayormmaDye sAntamanekaDA । aparaM nawaveSena maDye taM muralIDaram ॥ gopIgaRamuKAmBojamaDupAnamaDuvratam । kulAlacakrapratimaM maRqalaM paNkajANkitam ॥ dalAzwaSoBitaM kAryyaM mahizyo'zwO ca sanDizu । maDye maDye ca govindaM pArSvayorazwarUpakam ॥ mukundaM mADavaM kfzRaM nawanAgarameva ca । hariM dAmodaraM vizRuM pUjayet kAmarUpiRam ॥ tadvAhye BUpure gopyaH SataSo'Ta sahasraSaH । pUjanIyAH prayatnena nftyagItaparAyaRAH ॥ asaMKyA gopikAstatra maRqale'zwO varANganAH । mahizyastAH samAKyAtAH sadAsaNgamunivratAH ॥ BaktotsavABilAsena kamalA bahurUpiRI । rADA viSAKA vimalA sumitrA lalitA taTA । sundarI kamalA ramBA mahizyo'zwO prakIrttitAH ॥ tArA rADA nirAvADA kfzRA BedamupAgatAH । tAsAM DyAnErvvakzyamAREH pUjA kAryyA viSezataH ॥ uttIrRe sAyaM samaye gopyo vfndAvanaM yayuH । rAsakrIqAM tatastABiScakre ca jagadISvaraH ॥ gopyo rAsakrIqAM cakruH pOrRamAsyAM mahAniSi । na tatra pakzininado na JillIninadastaTA ॥ mahAniSA dve Gawike rAtrermmaDyamayAmayoH । tadaprAptO ca karttavyaM pOrRamAsyAM niSAmuKe ॥ evaM rAsakrIqAM yastu kArayedBuvi mAnavaH । sa sarvvaduskftaM tyaktvA nirvvARamuktimApnuyAt ॥” ityutkalakalikA ॥ (vilAsaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 5 । 2 । 12 । “asmadviDasya mana unnayanO biBartti bahvadButaM sarasarAsasuDAdivaktre ॥” “baktre ca bahvadButaM biBartti kiM tadAha । raso maDurAlApaH rAso vilAsastAByAM sahitA suDA aDarAmftam । AdiSabdAt smitanarmmAdi .” iti tatra SrIDarasvAmI ॥ kriyA । yaTA, BAgavate । 5 । 13 । 17 । “tErvaYcito haMsakulaM samAviSat narocayan SIlamupEti vAnarAn । tajjAtirAsena sunirvftendriyaH parasparodbIkzaRavismftAvaDiH ॥” “tErvaYcitastatra PalABAvaM jYAtvA haMsAnAM brAhmaRAnAM kulaM punaH praviSan tezAM SIlaM prAyaScittapUrvvakaM punarupanayanAdyAcAramarocayan apriyaM paSyan vAnaratulyAn BrazwAcArAn SUdraprAyAnupEti । tajjAtirAsena vAnarajAtikriyayA striyAM miTunIBUya parasparamuKodvIkzaRena vismfto jIvitAvaDirmaraRakAlo yena .” iti tawwIkAyAM SrIDarasvAmI ॥ * ॥)

m: रास m. uproar, noise, din, L.
N. of a partic. rustic dance practised by cowherds, (esp.) the dance practised by Kṛṣṇa and the Gopīs, Hariv.; Pur.; Gīt. &c. (cf. रासक)
any sport or play, L.
a legend (?), in नर्मदा-सुन्दरी-र्˚ (q.v.)
= भाषा-शृङ्खलक, L.
a: रासः — 1 An uproar, a din, confused noise. --2 A sound in general. --3 Speech. --4 A kind of dance practised by Kṛṣṇa and the cowherds but particularly the gopis or cowherdesses of Vṛndāvana; उत्सृज्य रासे रसं गच्छंतीं Ve. 1. 2; रासे हरिमिह विहितविलासं स्मरति मनो मम कृतपरिहासं Gīt. 2; also Gīt. 1. --5 A chain. --Comp. --ईश्वरी N. of Rādhā. --क्रीडा, --मंडलं a sportive dance, the circular dance of Kṛṣṇa and the cowherdesses of Vṛndāvana.

m: रास्नाका f. a small girdle or band, Kāṭh.
रास्नाव mfn. having a girdle, girdled, girt, ŚBr.
रासोल्लास-तन्त्र n. N. of a Tantra.
रास्प See रास्पिर below.
रास्पिन mfn. (prob. connected with √ 1. रस्, 1. रास्, रप्, and said to mean, ‘sounding, noisy, loud’, RV. i, 122, 4; cf. Nir. vi, 21).
रास्पिर mfn. (prob.) id., RV. v, 43, 14 (Sāy. ‘the Hotṛ who holds the sacrificial ladle’, fr. a word रास्प = 2. जुकू).
रास्य See गो-रास्य.
